archetypes.name: session-selection
archetypes.rationale: Selection semantics changed from tmpdir activity to pointer freshness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review progress-report candidate discovery for mixed implement and design sessions. Focus on whether pointer mtime is consistently applied for implement runs without weakening dangling-pointer and canonical-cwd safeguards. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
